title: Titanium Cryogenic H2 Flange Bolt
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for Titanium Cryogenic H2 Flange Bolt where formability and corrosion resistance are prioritized over absolute strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, Grade 2 CP-Ti forms a stable TiO₂ passive film that provides immunity to pitting in chloride environments up to 260°C. Its 345 MPa yield strength with 30% elongation makes it ideal for Liquid hydrogen cryogenic flange bolt (Grade 23) requiring cold forming or bending without cracking. This rationale is driven by liquid hydrogen cryogenic flange bolt (grade 23) and specific design requirements.
process: Closed-die forging net shape for hydrogen hardware geometry
CNC precision machining with 0.5mm corner radius
TIG welding all positions with 0.5mm corner radius
DPI dye penetrant inspect with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Thermal oxidation 700C 2h in air to grow controlled 300nm TiO2 barrier layer for H2 permeation reduction — tailored for liquid hydrogen cryogenic application
inspection: UT volumetric full matrix (liquid hydrogen verified)
commonFailures: Thermal ratcheting under cyclic temperature - controlled by stress-relief anneal 675C 2h Ar below beta-transus — critical for liquid hydrogen cryogenic performance

faq.q: What downhole temperature rating does Titanium Cryogenic H2 Flange Bolt have?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti maintains >90% of room-temperature tensile and yield strength at 200°C and >80% at 300°C. Titanium Cryogenic H2 Flange Bolt is suitable for liquid hydrogen cryogenic in geothermal (HDR/EGS) wells up to 300°C with appropriate consideration of creep in threaded connections. Above 300°C, dedicated creep testing per ASTM E139 is recommended for design life validation.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Cryogenic H2 Flange Bolt orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Cryogenic H2 Flange Bolt is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Cryogenic H2 Flange Bolt?
faq.a: Each Titanium Cryogenic H2 Flange Bolt shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for liquid hydrogen cryogenic.
